text: The second irreducible failure is the unreliability of logical reasoning: even within situations a specification describes, human institutions draw conclusions from inconsistent premises, apply rules inconsistently across cases, and miss implications of the rules they hold.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Governance as a Product (GaaP): A Reputation-Weighted Institutional Architecture for Autonomous AI Agent Governance (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6886078
